However, once they arrived at the planet, the fleet was split up into many small groups by a metor shower, each of one colonial ship and varying numbers of ships for travel on and around Solus. Some of these groups, missing colonization equipment, were lost. Others had their communications damaged in the storm, yet made colonies, but have still not been able to repair their communications sufficiently to find the other cites. A few groups retained both communication and colonization equipment, and are in contact with Earth. The cites then began the earth-ifieing process, creating an atmosphere from the compressed gasses carried on the ships under polymer domes that were included in the colonization equipment. This was followed by a breaking up of the rock surrounding the cities, forming dirt. Earth plants were planted in the dirt, soon to spread naturally. The terraforming process was also gradually induced outside the domes.

In a last-ditch effort to escape, Bullallin led an attack to capture one of the government's starships. Many of the resistance force were lost in the battle, but they were able to capture the ship and escape the pursuing forces. Bullallin's aim is now to recruit soldiers from other parts of Solus, then return to Dominium and liberate it.
